vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --stats_text --quiet --force_overwrite --dir plugin_data/vepdir --dir_plugins {plugins} --plugin GWAS,file=plugin_data/gwas_catalog_slice.tsv [--tab|--vcf|--json]
input: variants.vcf: 36 records at chromosome 21 sites, one record per allele except one multi-allelic record. Ten SNVs at eight sites the catalog reports from one study each, carrying a beta coefficient with its unit, an odds ratio, a ratio without a confidence interval, no ratio, no reported gene and a gene list; four SNVs at sites several studies report, where the order of the plugin's processed file decides the record; two SNVs at sites whose first record in that order names another allele, so a later record is reported; the paired sites of a 25-SNP haplotype row, of a 9-SNP haplotype row and the second SNP of a SNP x SNP interaction row; an SNV whose allele is the complement of the site's risk allele, reported on no row; a multi-allelic record whose second allele is the site's risk allele, reported on the rows of both alleles; an insertion and a deletion at a catalog site, reported on no row; and thirteen records at ten sites of the summary statistics of GCST000028: six sites with one allele, the effect allele, three with two alleles of which one is the effect allele, and one with a deletion in place of an SNV.

sstate.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --stats_text --quiet --force_overwrite --dir plugin_data/vepdir --dir_plugins {plugins} --plugin GWAS,type=sstate,file=plugin_data/17463246-GCST000028-EFO_0001360.h.tsv [--tab|--vcf|--json]

data: plugin_data/gwas_catalog_slice.tsv: the header and the 43 rows of the NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog associations download (ontology-annotated, full) that name a chromosome 21 site of the records, every column kept; among them rows whose risk allele carries a ?, whose reported gene is NR or a list, and haplotype and interaction rows naming several sites. plugin_data/17463246-GCST000028-EFO_0001360.h.tsv: the header and 15 rows of the harmonised summary statistics of GCST000028, named as the catalog publishes the file: its first three rows, whose harmonised coordinates are NA, the rows at the records' sites and two more chromosome 21 rows; the file is uncompressed because Ensembl VEP's plugin reads the compressed bytes of a .gz file as its header. plugin_data/vepdir/: the processed, sorted and indexed copies of both files that Ensembl VEP's plugin writes under its --dir on a first run and reads on every run, written by that run and named through --dir so the reference run finds them on its read-only corpus; vep-rs reads the two source files and the flag is inert for it.
generator: tools/vep-golden-corpus select (--include for every record); scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --dir-plugins <VEP_plugins checkout> (the manifest's run and, with the manifest's flags set to the flag set's words, the sstate run); tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set, classify (both runs) and check
